CustomField.description: How the three verification gates (grounding, claim check, LLM verify) treat a failed would-be draft. 'block' (the code default when blank) = failure returns a NO_DRAFT_* outcome (fail-closed). 'demote' = failure stamps a [NEEDS REVIEW] warning at the top of AI Draft Notes, forces LOW confidence, and still produces a DRAFTED outcome for human review — drafts are never auto-sent, so demote trades reviewer attention for coverage.
CustomField.label: Draft Gate Mode
